static_analysis_fixed_justification: The confirmed workflow injection/credential findings were fixed. Medium-or-higher findings with medium-or-higher confidence fail CI. dynamic_analysis_justification: The exhaustive harness systematically varies every four-byte input on all five targets (21474836480 candidates), checking recognition, typed decode, exact encode and suffix independence. Longer fields have generated boundary/register probes; mutations test assertion strength. These are input-varying executable analyses, not merely a source-coverage claim. https://github.com/MattJackson/h8-asm/blob/main/examples/exhaustive.rs
dynamic_analysis_unsafe_justification: The library is entirely safe Rust and forbids unsafe code; it produces no memory-unsafe-language runtime component. The external GNU test oracle is not part of the delivered library.
dynamic_analysis_enable_assertions_justi: Debug-profile Cargo tests retain assertions and overflow checks in every OS/MSRV cell. Release-mode exhaustive sweeps use ordinary assert/ assert_eq checks, which remain active in release builds. https://github.com/MattJackson/h8-asm/blob/main/examples/exhaustive.rs
dynamic_analysis_fixed_justification: Behavioral defects identified by executable audits were fixed before release, with pinned censuses and regression assertions. signed_releases_justification: Release v0.5.0 includes the registry-identical crate, Sigstore signature/certificate/bundle and SLSA provenance. The release workflow verified signing; an independent download passed cosign verify-blob with exact release.yml@refs/heads/main identity and GitHub issuer, plus gh attestation verify restricted to the repository and release workflow. SHA-256: 07f60b20bbdeac16166434ca88ab1ea59438a0d5fcc79399c5efd6f7469c5a93. https://github.com/MattJackson/h8-asm/releases/tag/v0.5.0
version_tags_signed_justification: Release tags are annotated but are not themselves cryptographically signed. Signed crate artifacts/provenance are separate evidence and are not mislabeled as signed git tags. https://github.com/MattJackson/h8-asm/blob/main/.github/workflows/release.yml
input_validation_justification: Recognizers validate encoding masks, reserved fields, target/mode and truncation. Encoders verify full decoded semantics, and patch helpers use checked bounds and transactional plans. Safe Rust is required without runtime dependencies. https://github.com/MattJackson/h8-asm/blob/main/docs/ASSURANCE_CASE.md

name: h8-asm
description: A pure safe-Rust Renesas H8 family decoder, disassembler, instruction builder and transactional patching library for H8/300, H8/300H, H8S/2000, H8S/2600 and H8SX.
